mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , t1.bf_gyul_ymd AS bfGyulYmd , (t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1) AS bfStart , t1.af_gyul_ymd AS afGyulYmd , t1.haeji_ymd AS haejiYmd , (t1.haeji_ymd - 1) AS af FROM SZM0GI t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND (#{ymd} BETWEEN t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AND t1.af_gyul_ymd OR ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -12) BETWEEN t1.bf_gyul_ymd + 1 AND t1.af_gyul_ymd) AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND F_FUND_SUCCESS(#{corpGr}, t1.fund_cd, t1.af_gyul_ymd) = 'ok' ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC
